name: legal_zones
_comment: Hand-drawn APPROXIMATE outlines (lon/lat). no_entry = designated protected sites a march cannot enter (Serious Organised Crime and Police Act 2005 s.128); restricted_activity = controlled area where tents/amplified noise are prohibited but processions can pass (Police Reform and Social Responsibility Act 2011 s.142-143). Royal Parks are added from OSM open_spaces at load time. Event-specific s.12/s.14 conditions are not included.
